verdict.rationale: The only hint of an official SDK is the Dataverse Web API docs contrasting the Web API with 'a specific NuGet package', which implies a first-party .NET package exists without naming or documenting it. The rest of the evidence covers the raw REST Web API and third-party class-generation libraries, which are building blocks or non-official tooling rather than official SDKs. Missing for 10: an explicitly named and documented official SDK, coverage of SDK languages and platforms, installation and usage docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: You might want to use the Web API when you don't want to take a dependency on a specific NuGet package
